_meta.name: serve-daemon-trigger-eval
_meta.description: Pre-launch trigger-eval gate for the `mix ash_agent.serve` MCP daemon. Each query is run against the daemon's tool descriptions by a real client; the query passes when the client triggers (or declines to trigger) exactly as `should_trigger` prescribes. Gate: 75% per-tool. Failures are labeled with the phxagents taxonomy: `missing_term` (the phrasing never matches), `too_broad` (triggered where it should not have), `neighbor_collision` (the right intent, wrong tool — e.g. answered by tidewave's project_eval or the shell instead).
_meta.mechanics: See README.md in this directory. Not wired into CI by design: run before merge with the daemon on a scratch port.
